title: Dating the Fitch Bandwagon radio show to 1942
summary: Pillars corrects Ross Russell, saying the radio popularity contest was in 1942, and his wife helped gather votes.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Mr. Russell -- Ross Russell in that same book, mentions the Pitch Bandwagon Radio Show.
Yeah, he says it's in the '30's, so we'll wait till we get to the '40's.

Right. It was in the '40's, yeah he was wrong. It was 1942. Cause I married in 1941, and my wife helped me, like mad, you know, to put out those -- voting things indifferent drug stores and all over town --
To get people to vote for our band.//
